entries.zh: 進德；在德行善道上日益长进
entries.en: to advance each day more in goodness/virtue (moral progress)
entries.notes: 四栏语义互证清晰，但 M 栏声调 T99 污損难辨，按纪律降 medium。

entries.zh: 又日新；每日愈发精进（语出《大学》"苟日新，日日新"之意）
entries.en: to renew oneself daily; to advance ever more each day

entries.zh: 徙善；迁善、趋于善德
entries.en: to move toward goodness; to advance in virtue
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:徙/徒]，字形有疑，展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 支撑、加固（以支柱撑住）
entries.en: to prop up, to shore up, to underpin
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:誅/註]，M 栏 (Eu)[圈] 污损；据西语 apuntalar 与官话 chǐ 推断。

entries.zh: 撑住、支住（疑为"松/枟"字形有误）
entries.en: to prop up, to support
entries.notes: 汉字 [疑:松/枟] 与西语 apuntalar 语义难合，M 栏仅 "qu."，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 支撑箱匣（"親塊佳"疑为"撑其块"，指撑住箱/柜之部件）
entries.en: to prop up the box/chest (caja)
entries.notes: M 栏两处 T99 污损，汉字栏 [疑]，caija 按 17 世纪拼写读作 caja（箱）。

entries.zh: 支撑、扶住（"親華"疑为"撑其"类词组之音写）
entries.en: to prop up, to support
entries.notes: 两处汉字均标 [疑]，M 栏一处污损，仅按西语 apuntalar 给通用义。

entries.zh: 支撑并抬举上去（"親上去"：撑住使之上去）
entries.en: to prop up and raise it up (apuntalar y levantarlo)
entries.notes: 汉字栏 [疑] 且 M 栏两处 T99 污损；deuantarlo 读作 levantarlo（抬起）。

entries.zh: 点；点注、加注记号
entries.en: to dot, to mark, to point out; to make a note

entries.zh: 点书、在书册上作批注记号
entries.en: to mark books; to annotate/make notes in a book

entries.zh: 在文籍图志上作点注记号（尤指在战事图记上标示）
entries.en: to mark the writing/documents; to note in the war charts
entries.notes: 西文 "notar en las Guerras unas." 断句存疑，语义依赖推断。

entries.zh: 抽头；记下开头要点以便记忆（起首作记）
entries.en: to note the beginning/heading so as to remember it
entries.notes: 西文跨行 "ha-der memoria"（ha de/hacer memoria）读法依赖推断。

entries.zh: 物成点；（果实、花）初现成熟将绽之点
entries.en: to begin to show (of fruit ripening or flower budding); to come to a point of ripening

entries.zh: 子午针；指南针、罗盘磁针
entries.en: the compass needle (meridian needle); the compass

entries.zh: 伊；那（远指代词，指那个/他）
entries.en: that one; he/she (demonstrative/third person)

entries.zh: 彼、其；那、那个（远指）
entries.en: that (masculine/neuter/feminine: aquel, aquello, aquella)
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损、R 栏仅 "Raj" 且无声调标记，音写可疑。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（汉字栏空缺，仅存音 guǐ，疑亦为远指词）
entries.en: [source damaged; gloss uncertain] that (demonstrative)
entries.notes: 汉字栏 [空]，无法与音写对证，按残缺纪律处理。

entries.zh: 其他、其事；那件事
entries.en: that matter/business; the other(s)

entries.zh: 于；（比较级用法之）于、比
entries.en: than/to (preposition used in comparative constructions)
entries.notes: 西文 "aquel mas comparatiue" 为语法提示语，所指依赖推断。

entries.zh: 他、别的；其他人/物
entries.en: other, others
entries.notes: M 栏音写 "Ia" 与 R 栏 "tǎ"（他）不一致，取舍依赖推断。
